items.title: Enhance Pricing Button with Alias URL and Bold Styling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the pricing button on the API docs page by linking it to a user-friendly alias URL instead of a UUID. Additionally, the button's styling has been upgraded from a ghost pill to a solid primary button, making it more visible and inviting for users. Internationalization support has also been added for all 12 locales, ensuring a consistent experience across languages.

items.title: Align Logout Icon with Label in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update fixes the alignment issue between the logout icon and its label in the sidebar. The logout element now uses the same grid structure as other menu items, ensuring consistent vertical alignment. The changes have been verified across desktop and mobile views, maintaining functionality and accessibility standards.

items.title: Update Sidebar Menu to 'Models & Pricing' in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: The sidebar menu on the console has been updated to reflect the accurate content of the models page, changing 'Model List' to 'Models & Pricing' across 12 languages. This change enhances clarity for users, indicating that the page includes both models and pricing information. The update involved no code changes, ensuring a seamless transition.

items.title: Enhance Analytics Layout for Clarity in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the layout of the analytics page by repositioning the date filters above the summary cards. Previously, users might have misunderstood the time range for the displayed metrics, as the filters were located below the cards. The change enhances user experience by making the filters more prominent and accessible.

items.title: Enhance row selection handling in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a safeguard in the email marketing recipient table to ensure that the toggleRowSelection function is only called when the table reference is ready. By implementing a check and retry mechanism, it prevents errors during the initial render, enhancing the stability of the campaign editor. The changes have been validated with successful tests and no eslint or type errors.

items.title: Enhance Image Editing Size Inference in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update fixes the issue where the `gpt-image-2` image editing feature returned a default 1:1 aspect ratio when no size was specified. The solution involves implementing size inference based on the input image's aspect ratio, ensuring that the output matches the intended dimensions. Key modifications were made across multiple handlers to support this functionality, along with comprehensive testing to validate the changes.

items.title: Enhance Tool Result Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves the issue of oversized tool results being truncated to a fixed 2000-character preview. Now, results are retained up to a specified ceiling of 20,000 characters, ensuring that larger outputs are fully represented. Key changes include a unified configuration for maximum result size and improvements to the serialization process to maintain accurate size reporting.

items.title: Fix video recovery issue in Platform Service 🎥
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where finished videos were incorrectly discarded due to a failure in the delivery detection process. The fix allows the system to recover nested bare MP4 files even when no manifest is present, ensuring that valid outputs are not lost. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate this behavior and ensure reliability.

items.title: Enhance error handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves error handling in the email marketing component by ensuring that the entire slot scope is guarded against undefined values. Changes were made to both the AudienceRecipientTable and AudienceProfileDrawer components to prevent console errors related to accessing properties of undefined. The fix maintains existing functionality while enhancing stability.

items.title: Revamp Email Marketing Opt-Out Model in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update transitions the email marketing strategy from an opt-in to an opt-out model for topic campaigns, allowing eligible users to receive emails unless they explicitly unsubscribe. Key changes include modifications to the eligible profiles query and email preparation logic to ensure compliance with subscription states. Additionally, several compliance issues identified during review have been addressed, enhancing the overall functionality and user experience.

items.title: Clarify Rendering Containers for Service Intro in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update revises the documentation to accurately describe how service intro pages render in both `.html-document-body` and `.markdown-body`. Key changes include clarifying button color rules to ensure consistency across both surfaces and preventing regression issues. The adjustments are purely documentation-focused, enhancing clarity for developers and avoiding future bugs.

items.title: Fix button text color for service intros in Backend 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where filled CTA buttons on the service intro pages displayed black text instead of white. By implementing container-agnostic CSS rules, the button text color is now consistently white across both service and documentation pages. The fix applies to the turnstile, discord-bot, and wechat-bot service intros, ensuring improved visibility and user experience.

items.title: Streamlining Browser Device Bridge for Efficiency in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive diagnosis and a streamlined PR plan aimed at reducing the complexity of the Browser Device Bridge. Key changes include the addition of two critical documents, archiving outdated designs, and updating the README to reflect the new simplified approach. The goal is to cut down the codebase from approximately 24,000 lines to under 6,000 lines, enhancing maintainability and performance.

items.title: Fix conformance test to be environment-independent in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a CI issue where the `/supported` conformance check failed due to the absence of a configured signer. By implementing a deterministic Base-only signer using `@override_settings`, the test now consistently returns a healthy V2 response, validating the response shape regardless of the environment. All tests have passed successfully, ensuring robust CI functionality.

items.title: Enhance x402 Documentation with Payment-Response Clarifications in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the x402 documentation regarding the optional `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header and introduces an optimal split-by-resource design. Key findings reveal that omitting the header has minimal impact, while the proposed tiers outline different approaches for handling receipts. The changes ensure compliance with the latest SDK specifications and improve clarity for developers.

items.title: Fix candidate preview to show real audience during pause in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a bug where the candidate preview would show an empty list when sending was paused, despite eligible profiles being available. The fix involves modifying the `eligible_profiles` function to allow real audience visibility during the preview while maintaining send restrictions. New tests have been added to ensure the functionality works as intended.

items.title: Fix recipient table crash on empty data in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug causing the Recipients table to crash when displaying empty or loading data. The fix involves changing the destructuring of the row property to use optional chaining, preventing errors when the scope is undefined. Additionally, the action column's fixed position has been removed to eliminate known triggers for this issue.

items.title: Align API Playground Tabs for a Sleeker Look in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update fixes the alignment issue of the 'Request' and 'Response' tabs in the API playground on the homepage. By changing the layout to inline-flex and adjusting the spacing, the icons now display neatly alongside the text. This enhancement improves the overall user experience and visual consistency.

items.title: Updated Card Pay-way Icon for Clarity in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update replaces the existing Card pay-way icon with a new, clearer bank-card graphic across the authenticated console order page and the anonymous public pay page. The change is purely a CSS asset URL swap, ensuring no logic or markup alterations. The new icon URL has been verified as reachable and functional.

items.title: Updated Card Pay-way Icon for Clarity in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update replaces the existing Card pay-way icon with a clearer bank-card graphic across two pages: the authenticated console order page and the anonymous public pay page. The change involves a simple asset URL swap in the scoped CSS, ensuring no logic or markup alterations. The new icon URL has been verified and is fully operational.

items.title: Align Icons in '为什么选择我们' Cards in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update centers the SVG icons in the '为什么选择我们' cards on the homepage, addressing a visual misalignment issue. The fix involved adjusting the CSS properties for the icon components to ensure they align properly with the text. No changes were made to the template or logic, and all tests passed successfully.

items.title: Documenting Key Design Decisions for Payment Responses in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update includes design notes for the `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header and the restructuring of the payment state table. Key options for handling the response header have been outlined, with a recommendation for an async receipt pointer approach. Additionally, the proposal to move the payment state to a dedicated table is discussed, emphasizing the need for this change post-V2 stabilization.

items.title: Enhance Core-V2 Conformance Suite for Facilitator in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update ports the 53-case core-v2 conformance manifest from the retired X402Backend, enabling the execution of 14 deterministic tests against the live X402SupportedView. The addition of these tests ensures a robust regression guard for the facilitator's advertised capabilities, maintaining compliance with the industry-standard contract. The changes include a new manifest and a dedicated test module, both of which have passed verification.

items.title: Retire X402Backend and Update Documentation in Index 🚀
items.summary: The standalone X402Backend has been retired, with documentation updated to reflect that x402 is now integrated into PlatformGateway. Key changes include marking the old route as superseded and removing the local X402Backend directory, which was never deployed. The core-v2 conformance suite has been successfully ported to Gateway CI.

items.title: Streamline x402 Payment Lane to V2 Only in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update standardizes the x402 payment lane to exclusively use the V2 specification, removing the legacy V1 `X-Payment` compatibility. Key changes include dropping the `X-Payment` branch in the authentication process, ensuring that both the body and header now align with V2 requirements. New tests have been added to validate the V2-only functionality, enhancing clarity and reducing potential client confusion.

items.title: Streamline Short-Drama Skill with Key Fixes in Platform Service 🎬
items.summary: This update focuses on cleaning up the SKILL.md file by removing outdated references and redundant narrative elements, ensuring the integrity of essential API details remains intact. Key changes include fixing a dangling reference from a previous PR and deleting unnecessary historical prose, resulting in a net reduction of 8 lines. The overall functionality and testing coverage have been preserved, with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Streamlined Story Governance with Deterministic Checks in Platform Service 🎭
items.summary: This update replaces the complex governance framework for short-drama story validation with a simplified, deterministic script. The new `check_story.py` ensures structural integrity of stories while reducing code complexity by over 2,300 lines. Key improvements include enhanced validation rules and a focus on maintaining the narrative spine without external dependencies.

items.title: Refine npm audit for production dependencies in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the npm audit command in the extension's package.json to include the --omit=dev flag, ensuring that only production dependencies are audited. This change prevents unnecessary failures due to high-severity vulnerabilities in development tooling, which do not impact the packaged extension. The audit now reports zero vulnerabilities, maintaining the integrity of the CI process.

items.title: Streamline x402 to Gateway V2, Retire X402Backend in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update consolidates the x402 functionality into the Gateway V2, effectively retiring the previously unused X402Backend. Key changes include the addition of a live V2 interop probe and a comprehensive architecture teardown document. The transition ensures that industry-standard V2 agents can now process payments seamlessly, enhancing overall system efficiency.

items.title: Update autoprefixer to latest version in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the autoprefixer package from version 10.5.2 to 10.5.4. Key improvements include fixes for prefixed rule duplication and enhancements to the gradient and bracket parsers, ensuring better CSS compatibility and performance.
